expectations.text: notes.md states the features consistently with the files: Source Serif 4 roman has onum, smcp, c2sc and case; Source Serif 4 italic has onum and case but no smcp or c2sc; Outfit has tnum but no onum, smcp, c2sc or case
expectations.evidence: notes.md table: roman onum/pnum complete, smcp/c2sc complete, case '( ) [ ] - – —'; italic smcp/c2sc '**absent**', onum complete, case 'same'; Outfit onum 'absent', tnum complete, smcp/c2sc absent, case absent. Matches ground truth.

expectations.text: article.css sets the Source Serif 4 body paragraphs in oldstyle figures (oldstyle-nums or "onum")
expectations.evidence: .prose 'font-variant-numeric: oldstyle-nums proportional-nums'; rendered p computes oldstyle-nums proportional-nums.

expectations.text: article.css sets abbr acronyms in the Source Serif 4 roman body in true small caps (all-small-caps, or c2sc plus smcp) with positive letter-spacing
expectations.evidence: '.prose abbr { font-variant-caps: all-small-caps; letter-spacing: 0.05em; }'; rendered roman abbr all-small-caps, 0.9px.

expectations.text: Acronyms inside em passages cannot be rendered as synthesized small caps: font-synthesis (or font-synthesis-small-caps) is none for them, or article.css resets them to normal capitals, and notes.md or a comment says the italic has no small caps
expectations.evidence: '.prose em abbr { font-variant-caps: normal; letter-spacing: 0.03em; }' plus font-synthesis: none; rendered em abbr caps normal, synthesis-small-caps none. Comment: 'The italic file has neither smcp nor c2sc'.

expectations.text: article.css requests no oldstyle figures, small caps or case-sensitive forms (no oldstyle-nums, onum, small-caps, all-small-caps, smcp, c2sc or "case") for Outfit text, unless a comment beside the rule says the font lacks the feature and the rule is inert
expectations.evidence: Outfit contexts request only lining/tabular/proportional nums and 'font-variant-caps: normal'; '.prose :is(h2, h3, .eyebrow, table) abbr { font-variant-caps: normal; }' so abbr in any Outfit context renders normal caps (verified).

expectations.text: article.css sets the results table numbers in Outfit with tabular-nums and gives the uppercase .eyebrow positive letter-spacing
expectations.evidence: Table in var(--font-ui) Outfit with 'lining-nums tabular-nums' (rendered td Outfit, tabular-nums); .eyebrow 'letter-spacing: 0.08em'.

expectations.text: article.css declares the Source Serif 4 roman and italic files and the Outfit file in @font-face with weight ranges, the italic with font-style: italic, and disables font-synthesis for the text
expectations.evidence: @font-face: roman 200 900, italic 200 900 'font-style: italic', Outfit 100 900; all loaded. '.prose { font-synthesis: none; }'.

expectations.text: Rendered at a 1280px-wide viewport with Source Serif 4 and English sample prose, full body lines in .prose average between 58 and 74 characters
